summary: Comprehensive test suite with 37 unit tests and 3 act integration tests covering all major features (parsing both package.json and requirements.txt, license policy classification, database lookup, CLI orchestration, report formatting, and workflow structure). Tests verify correct dependencies extraction, version normalization, status classification (approved/denied/unknown), case-insensitive policy matching, deny-list precedence, error handling for missing files and invalid JSON, exact output matching for CI assertions, and GitHub Actions workflow triggers/permissions/steps. Design is well-organized by feature with good fixture management and independent test isolation. Clever use of path filtering (`bun test tests/` vs root-level act-harness.test.ts) avoids nested-act issues. Gaps: missing test for empty dependencies list formatting (feature exists in code but untested), some CLI error scenarios (parse errors in policy/database files) not explicitly covered, boundary conditions like empty allow/deny lists not directly tested, pre-release version normalization not verified. Would effectively catch regressions in core functionality but misses some edge cases.
